opening.argument: The presentation promotes Baked Beans with earnings of up to 8% daily, directs viewers to deposit BNB, and explains a recurring compounding and withdrawal cycle to maintain those rewards. BNB hires the miners that produce rewards, while the interface displays rewards alongside RE-BAKE and EAT BEANS controls. It also presents BCT staking as a route to high APY, walking viewers through swapping for BCT, approving it, and staking it, with the interface inviting deposits for rewards. These are concrete instructions to commit funds to mining and staking mechanisms promoted for returns, establishing the scam case. The 8% rate is described as not guaranteed; that qualification limits the earnings claim but does not erase the promotion of deposits for returns.
